name: f(x) USD Saving
oneLiner: fxSAVE is the yield-bearing vault receipt over f(x) Protocol's fxUSD savings strategy, inheriting fxUSD's WBTC and wstETH CDP collateral risk.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: fxSAVE is the documented tokenized ERC-4626 Stability Pool vault over fxUSD/fxSP, so its parent fxUSD transfer-risk remains the applicable inherited exposure. At Ethereum block 25535189 (2026-07-15), proxy 0x7743e50f534a7f9f1791dde7dcd89f7783eefc39 resolved through its EIP-1967 implementation slot to verified SavingFxUSD implementation 0xe4031e271809d20074e4bef1caeefec5f710e8a6, and asset() returned fxSP 0x65c9a641afceb9c0e6034e558a319488fa0fa3be. The verified current implementation contains ordinary ERC20/ERC4626 transfers and no pause, blacklist, freeze, recipient-blocklist, or arbitrary-holder-burn path. CLAIM_FOR_ROLE gates claimFor() for a previously initiated redemption claim; it does not bypass the ERC20/ERC4626 allowance and share-burn checks for outstanding fxSAVE shares. ProxyAdmin 0x9b54b7703551d9d0ced177a78367560a8b2edda4 is owned by timelock 0x68863fb8855b04509a835082478d6e3d0be4e61a with a 259200-second delay, so this direct-code finding is upgrade-bound. No direct override is authored: the inherited status preserves the separately confirmed fxUSD parent pause exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 access review

collateral: ERC-4626 vault receipt over the f(x) Protocol V2 Stability Pool (fxSP / FxUSDBasePool), whose direct underlying is fxUSD plus a USDC reserve leg (currently fxUSD-dominant); auto-compounds wstETH/WBTC and Aave yield into more fxUSD and USDC. Backing inherits fxUSD's WBTC and wstETH CDP collateral base plus the USDC leg and strategy/oracle execution risk
pegMechanism: fxSAVE is an auto-compounding ERC-4626 vault over the f(x) Protocol V2 Stability Pool (fxSP); holders redeem shares for fxSP and exit the pool to a fxUSD+USDC mix, then inherit fxUSD's CDP redemption and liquidation mechanics (Stability Pool arbitrages the USDC/fxUSD Curve pool to defend the peg)

oracleRisk.summary: fxSAVE is an ERC-4626 vault over the f(x) Stability Pool and has no borrower-owned collateral positions or token-level liquidation engine. Its required fxUSD parent carries the separately reviewed WBTC and wstETH oracle and liquidation branches.

branchApplicability.rationale: f(x) documents fxSAVE as a tokenized ERC-4626 Stability Pool vault that compounds rewards into fxUSD and USDC. Holders mint and redeem vault shares; fxSAVE does not create borrower debt positions or collateral-ratio-triggered liquidation markets. The variantOf relationship preserves the complete fxUSD parent branch review.

mintAuthority.summary: fxSAVE is a strategy-vault receipt over f(x) Protocol's fxUSD savings strategy; shares are minted against deposited fxUSD and do not create base fxUSD supply, so its mint authority is inherited from fxUSD (fxusd-f-x-protocol). Wrapper upgrade is guarded by a ProxyAdmin whose owner is an AladdinDAO TimelockController with a 3-day delay.

controls.label: AladdinDAO 3-day TimelockController (fxSAVE ProxyAdmin owner)

controls.label: Inherited fxUSD CDP mint path
controls.capDescription: Underlying fxUSD is minted only against overcollateralized wstETH/WBTC CDP positions inside f(x) Protocol; fxSAVE cannot create base fxUSD outside that parent path.
controls.evidence: The separately reviewed fxUSD parent establishes this collateralized CDP mint path at Ethereum block 25294712. fxSAVE holds the fxUSD Stability Pool receipt and inherits that base-asset authority; it has no separate off-protocol issuer minter.

review.evidence: fxSAVE (variantOf fxusd-f-x-protocol, variantKind strategy-vault) is a yield-bearing vault receipt over fxUSD. At Ethereum block 25573280, asset() confirmed the fxUSD Stability Pool and the proxy chain resolved to ProxyAdmin 0x9b54b7703551d9d0ced177a78367560a8b2edda4 owned by TimelockController 0x68863fb8855b04509a835082478d6e3d0be4e61a with a 259200-second minimum delay. No privileged share mint outside deposit accounting was found; changing that accounting requires the delayed upgrade path. The wrapper has no issuer reserve or named prudential supervisor of its own.
